evidence.actual: Callback URL mismatch. http://app.example.com/callback is not in the list of allowed callback URLs

evidence.note: Request uses http scheme; registered URI uses https.
Only the https URI is registered; exact match is required.

output.fix: Make the app send redirect_uri exactly as registered: https://app.example.com/callback. Change the scheme from http to https in the authorization request or app config. Don't register the http URI as a workaround, because that allows an insecure callback. Check that the registered URI matches exactly, including scheme, host, path and trailing slash.

alternatives.why_not: The error text names the callback URL list specifically, so this is a redirect URI mismatch and not a broader client configuration problem.
